description: This file defines the RemotePortTunnel class responsible for creating, managing, and cleaning up SSH port forwarding tunnels in a remote mode of a network application. It includes methods for establishing a tunnel, selecting an available port, checking port availability, and handling process stderr output.

classes.name: RemotePortTunnel
classes.description: Final class that manages SSH port forwarding tunnels, providing creation, termination, port availability checks, and stderr handling.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Asynchronously creates and starts a new SSH tunnel, selecting an available local port and configuring SSH options.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Terminates the SSH process and performs cleanup.
